CURRENT QUESTION:
Gaya and Nalanda 2022 2023 show institutional delivery and postnatal percentages of registrations
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH institutional_delivery AS (
  SELECT
    "district",
    "year",
    "pregnancies_registered",
    "institutional_deliveries",
    (CAST("institutional_deliveries" AS FLOAT) / NULLIF("pregnancies_registered", 0)) * 100 AS institutional_delivery_percentage
  FROM
    "maternal_services"
  WHERE
    "district" IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND
    "year" IN (2022, 2023)
),
postnatal_check AS (
  SELECT
    "district",
    "year",
    "pregnancies_registered",
    "postnatal_check_48h",
    (CAST("postnatal_check_48h" AS FLOAT) / NULLIF("pregnancies_registered", 0)) * 100 AS postnatal_check_percentage
  FROM
    "maternal_services"
  WHERE
    "district" IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND
    "year" IN (2022, 2023)
)
SELECT
  id."district",
  id."year",
  id.institutional_delivery_percentage,
  pc.postnatal_check_percentage
FROM
  institutional_delivery id
JOIN
  postnatal_check pc
ON
  id."district" = pc."district" AND
  id."year" = pc."year"
ORDER BY
  id."district",
  id."year";
```
